patients.name: Lakshmi Devi
patients.dosage: Metformin 500mg twice daily after breakfast and dinner. Amlodipine 5mg once daily in the morning. Aspirin 75mg once daily after lunch.
patients.foodInstructions: Strictly avoid sugar, sweets, white rice, and fried foods. Eat small meals every 3 hours. Prefer ragi, brown rice, and green vegetables. Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily.
restrictions: No white rice — switch to brown rice or ragi
Avoid stress and heavy physical activity for 2 weeks
warningSigns: Chest pain or shortness of breath
Numbness or tingling in hands or feet
patients.doctorNote: Patient was admitted for 3 days due to uncontrolled blood sugar (HbA1c 9.2%). Blood pressure was 160/100 on admission, now stable at 130/85. Patient must monitor blood sugar at home every morning before breakfast and log the readings. Bring the log book to the follow-up visit. If blood sugar is above 300 mg/dL on any day, visit the emergency immediately.
